notes.title: You Helped Fat Chicken and We're Super Grateful!
notes.content:
Hello Early Access supporters! We're happy to announce that Fat Chicken will be coming out of Early Access today. You're feedback and help have been very important to us as we squashed bugs and finished up the balancing.

We'll be pushing a game update later today with a list of improvements that we're eager to share with you. Stay tuned!

notes.title: FINAL DAY FOR LAUNCH SALE
notes.content:
Today is the last day of the launch sale to receive 15% off all Fat Chicken bundles in the store! Bundles are as follows:

1. Fat Chicken Standalone Version 
2. Fat Chicken OST Edition: This includes both the game and the 17 track soundtrack by Jason Graves.
3. Fat Chicken Early Access Edition: Includes 2 copies of Fat Chicken - A copy for you and an extra copy for a friend! Also included is OST.

notes.title: Early Access Launch Day!!!
notes.content:
It's definitely exciting to think that players will begin playing the game we've worked so hard on tonight. All of us at Relevant Games, and Mighty Rabbit Studios thank you for the support, comments and Greenlight votes for Fat Chicken.

We're eager to hear your thoughts, feedback and ideas about improving Fat Chicken. We all want it to be all it can be, and with your help, feedback and guidance, it will get there. We're listening...  Enjoy!
